_comment: Single source of truth for Video RLVO frame sampling.
Neither runtime may hardcode these numbers — that is the duplication this file removes.
Tiers are matched in order; the first whose maxSeconds >= duration wins, and a null
maxSeconds means unbounded, so it must be last.
_endEpsilonComment: The final sample targets the end of the video. Seeking to exactly `duration` frequently
yields no decodable frame — the last frame is presented slightly before the reported
duration — so the final target is pulled back by this many seconds. 0.05s is under two
frames at 25fps, so it still lands on the closing moment.
